title: SongStyle
description: MUSIC-STUDIO-S2. A saved way a song should sound: the style words and a few knobs, never lyrics. It is the one 'make one like this' shape: the starter shelf, a made song's 'Make one like this' and 'Create a song like this' (MUSIC-LIKE-01) all produce one, and a made band (made-artist) holds the same `style` shape for every track it makes. Person scope; `origin` says whether MaiPai ships it or the household saved it. The style words are a person's own words, so a hub never logs them (rule 6a). Lyrics are never stored here and a seed's lyrics, melody or voice are never copied.

title.description: What the person calls this style. Trimmed; not unique.

origin.description: starter: ships with Music. household: a person saved it.

owner_person_id.description: Whose style this is; null for a starter.

source.description: hub: authoritative on the hub. local: made on a robot, not yet synced.

provenance.description: Free text naming who made the record, for example 'person-a1b2c3 (self)' or 'starter'.

deleted_at.description: Set when the style is deleted, so a syncing client drops it.

style.description: The ONE style shape. SongStyle holds one; MadeArtist holds one that every track of the band reuses. Words only: never lyrics.

description.description: The style words handed to the song engine (genre, mood, instruments, era). Never lyrics.

genres.description: Short genre words, for browsing and for the band's page.

length_s.description: Wanted length in seconds; null lets the engine choose.

language.description: A BCP 47 tag for the sung language; null lets the engine choose.

seed.description: The ONE field that says what a style or a band was made 'like': a file made here (a song the household made) or a library item (a track the household holds). An input description only: the original audio is never sent to the engine (voice, cover and edit sources stay closed, MUSIC-GEN-14), and the seed's lyrics, melody and voice are never copied. Exactly one of the two ids; the property that holds it is null when there is none.

file_id.description: A song made here (a file with origin made).

shared_to.description: Null is private. 'household' shares with everyone in the household; a list shares with those people. A child's records are never shared outside the household.
